bibl.title: The role of the inferior colliculus in a genetic model of audiogenic seizures

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: mechanism
span.quote: Finally, the use of knife cuts through the midbrain indicated that the ICCN sends an important projection to the external nucleus and that this projection plays a vital role in the propagation of seizure activity from the site of seizure initiation in the ICCN.

span.label: audiogenic seizures
span.quote: Previous studies have shown the functional importance of the inferior colliculus (IC) for the propagation and initiation of audiogenic seizures in several models of epilepsy in rats.

span.label: review
span.quote: This review provides a summary of the data that show a role for the IC in audiogenic seizures.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: GABA is taken back up more efficiently in the ICCN of GEPR-9s, so less GABA remains in the synapse to reach postsynaptic GABA receptors, inhibition is weakened, and seizures start in that nucleus despite the extra GABAergic neurons.
span.quote: Evidence is accumulating for the hypothesis that the uptake of GABA is more efficient in the ICCN of GEPR- 9s, and thus less GABA is available to interact with postsynaptic GABA receptors.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Alternatively, excitation is enhanced in the ICCN through overexpression of glutamate receptors, which would fit the raised glutamate and aspartate levels measured there.
span.quote: Another hypothesis to explain the initiation of seizure activity from the ICCN is that excitation is enhanced in the ICCN of GEPR-9s.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Seizure activity initiated in the ICCN is carried out of the colliculus along the bilateral ICCN-to-external-nucleus projection and onward to the superior colliculus and pontine reticular formation.
span.quote: Both results from our study of lesions in the coronal plane (Ribak et al. 1994) and anatomical studies that show the ICCN projects bilaterally to the EN (Coleman and Clerici 1987; Saldafia and Merchfin 1992) support the hypothesis that this pathway conveys seizure activity.

span.label: How the surplus of small GABAergic neurons produces the observed pharmacological defects at GABAergic synapses is unresolved.
span.quote: It remains to be resolved how the increase in small GABAergic neurons in the ICCN is responsible for the known pharmacological defects observed at GABAergic synapses.

span.label: The contribution of other brainstem structures to seizure propagation has not been established.
span.quote: Further studies are required to determine the relationship of these other structures to the propagation of seizure activity in the brain of GEPRs.

span.label: The two candidate mechanisms offered for seizure initiation remain untested.
span.quote: Two hypotheses will be tested in future studies: (1) increased GABA uptake, and (2) increased glutamate receptor expression.

span.label: The animal strains are named by their assigned score on a 0-9 behavioural rating scale.
span.quote: A rat strain that displays moderate seizures (running phase and forelimb/hindlimb clonus) and has an assigned seizure score of 3 (GEPR-3) is also used as an animal model for AGS

span.label: The rating scale's levels are defined by observed behaviour, and the paper prints them.
span.quote: Genetically epilepsy-prone rats (GEPRs) exhibit convulsions when exposed to sound stimulus, and the seizures are scored on a 0-9 scale (0 being no seizure, and 9 being one fit of wild running and an accompanying tonic seizure

span.label: The cell-type census of the region is stated as a suggestion from these results.
span.quote: These results suggest that of the six major cell types in the ICCN, four are GABAergic inhibitory neurons

span.label: GEPR-3
span.quote: A rat strain that displays moderate seizures (running phase and forelimb/hindlimb clonus) and has an assigned seizure score of 3 (GEPR-3) is also used as an animal model for AGS

span.label: seizure score
span.quote: A rat strain that displays moderate seizures (running phase and forelimb/hindlimb clonus) and has an assigned seizure score of 3 (GEPR-3) is also used as an animal model for AGS

span.label: animal model
span.quote: A rat strain that displays moderate seizures (running phase and forelimb/hindlimb clonus) and has an assigned seizure score of 3 (GEPR-3) is also used as an animal model for AGS

span.label: Genetically epilepsy-prone rats
span.quote: Genetically epilepsy-prone rats (GEPRs) exhibit convulsions when exposed to sound stimulus, and the seizures are scored on a 0-9 scale (0 being no seizure, and 9 being one fit of wild running and an accompanying tonic seizure

span.label: GABAergic inhibitory neurons
span.quote: These results suggest that of the six major cell types in the ICCN, four are GABAergic inhibitory neurons

span.label: GEPR-3 - A STRAIN NAME THAT IS A SCALE SCORE: a rat strain showing moderate seizures is assigned a seizure score of 3 and thereby designated GEPR-3, so a behavioural rating becomes a strain name and then a fixed kind of animal; a later comparison of GEPR-3 with GEPR-9 compares two points on an ordinal scale that have been reified into two categories
span.quote: A rat strain that displays moderate seizures (running phase and forelimb/hindlimb clonus) and has an assigned seizure score of 3 (GEPR-3) is also used as an animal model for AGS

span.label: the seizure score - A 0-9 ORDINAL WITH BEHAVIOURAL ENDPOINTS: 0 is no seizure and 9 is one fit of wild running with an accompanying tonic seizure, so the scale is anchored in observable behaviour and the number that travels in a strain name is a rank on it
span.quote: Genetically epilepsy-prone rats (GEPRs) exhibit convulsions when exposed to sound stimulus, and the seizures are scored on a 0-9 scale (0 being no seizure, and 9 being one fit of wild running and an accompanying tonic seizure

span.label: the ICCN cell-type count - OFFERED AS A SUGGESTION: the authors write that these results SUGGEST four of the six major cell types are GABAergic inhibitory neurons, so the census is a reading of the data rather than an enumeration
span.quote: These results suggest that of the six major cell types in the ICCN, four are GABAergic inhibitory neurons

span.label: builds-on → Faingold et al. (1986a) hypothesis that GABA uptake is more efficient in the ICCN of GEPR-9s
span.quote: The observations that the GABA transporter, GAT-1, is localized to GABA neurons in several brain regions (Brecha and Weigman 1994) and that increased numbers of GABA neurons exist in the ICCN of GEPR-9s are consistent with this hypothesis, originally proposed by Faingold et al. (1986a).

span.label: contradicts → the disinhibition account carried over from hippocampal dentate gyrus findings (Farias et al. 1992; Buckmaster and Schwartzkroin 1994)
span.quote: This hypothesis was tested with an electron microscopic analysis in GEPR-9s, but the data were not consistent with it, because the number of axosomatic synapses per soma in the ICCN of GEPR-9s was not different from that of SD rats (Roberts and Ribak 1988).

span.label: builds-on → Faye-Lund and Osen's (1985) description of the rat inferior colliculus
span.quote: The IC of rats was elegantly described by Faye-Lund and Osen (1985).

span.label: GEPR-3 —is-a→ animal model
span.quote: A rat strain that displays moderate seizures (running phase and forelimb/hindlimb clonus) and has an assigned seizure score of 3 (GEPR-3) is also used as an animal model for AGS

span.label: correlation
span.quote: The coefficient of linear correlation was calculated to be 0.91, thus indicating that a significant correlation exists between audiogenic response score and small neuronal number in the ICCN.

span.label: correlation
span.quote: In comparing the audiogenic response score of GEPR-9s, SD rats, and the offspring of GEPR-9 X SD rat crosses, a significant positive correlation was established between the number of small neurons in the ICCN and the audiogenic response score (Ribak et al. 1988b).

span.label: significance test
span.quote: Statistically significant increases were also observed in the two other subdivisions.

span.label: mean
span.quote: The average number of small neurons in the ICCN of GEPR-3s was 29.50+2.17 cells per unit area.

span.label: cell counting (stereological-style counts per section)
span.quote: Counts were made of the total number of Nissl-stained cells in the ICCN, and in addition, the three different sizes of ICCN neurons were separately counted (Roberts et al. 1985b).

span.label: Epilepsy-prone GEPR-9 rats have far more GAD-positive (GABAergic) neurons in the inferior colliculus than non-seizing Sprague-Dawley rats, with the excess concentrated where the central nucleus is largest.
span.quote: However, a dramatic increase in the number of GADpositive neurons was found in the IC of GEPR-9s as compared to that of SD rats (Fig. 7).

span.label: The same increase was obtained by two independent anatomical techniques, GAD immunocytochemistry and GAD67 mRNA in situ hybridization.
span.quote: Two independent anatomical methods were used to determine the number of GABAergic neurons, immunocytochemistry and in situ hybridization.

span.label: Nissl counts show the total neuron number in the ICCN is also raised in GEPR-9s, so the extra GABAergic cells are additional neurons and not existing neurons that switched to a GABAergic phenotype.
span.quote: This Nissl analysis of IC neurons indicated that the increase was not due to a change in the phenotype of collicular neurons from non-GABAergic to GABAergic.

span.label: Across GEPR-9s, Sprague-Dawley rats and their crossed offspring, the number of small neurons in the ICCN rises together with the audiogenic response score.
span.quote: In comparing the audiogenic response score of GEPR-9s, SD rats, and the offspring of GEPR-9 X SD rat crosses, a significant positive correlation was established between the number of small neurons in the ICCN and the audiogenic response score (Ribak et al. 1988b).

span.label: Moderately seizing GEPR-3 rats have significantly more small ICCN neurons than Sprague-Dawley rats, and the count matches the value the correlation line predicted in advance.
span.quote: This value was significantly greater than that of SD rats and was similar to the value predicted by the linear relationship shown in Fig. 11.

span.label: Knife cuts placed between the central and external nuclei of the IC block audiogenic seizures, as do lesions of the ICCN itself or of the lateral lemniscus.
span.quote: We found that not only are seizures blocked by ICCN or lateral lemniscus lesions, but lesions between the external and central nuclei of the IC also blocked seizures (Fig. 12).

span.label: The ICCN-to-external-nucleus projection is the route by which seizure activity leaves its site of initiation in the ICCN and propagates.
span.quote: Finally, the use of knife cuts through the midbrain indicated that the ICCN sends an important projection to the external nucleus and that this projection plays a vital role in the propagation of seizure activity from the site of seizure initiation in the ICCN.

span.label: The number of axosomatic synapses per soma in the ICCN is the same in GEPR-9s and Sprague-Dawley rats, which rules out the idea that the extra GABAergic neurons act by adding inhibitory contacts onto cell bodies.
span.quote: This hypothesis was tested with an electron microscopic analysis in GEPR-9s, but the data were not consistent with it, because the number of axosomatic synapses per soma in the ICCN of GEPR-9s was not different from that of SD rats (Roberts and Ribak 1988).

span.label: Seizure-prone offspring outnumber seizure-resistant offspring in GEPR-9 x Sprague-Dawley crosses by more than three to one, indicating that audiogenic-seizure susceptibility is inherited as an autosomal dominant trait.
span.quote: This finding and others indicated that AGS susceptibility in GEPRs is an autosomal dominant trait (Ribak et al. 1988b).

span.label: Electron microscopy indicates that four of the six major cell types of the central nucleus of the inferior colliculus are GABAergic inhibitory neurons.
span.quote: These results suggest that of the six major cell types in the ICCN, four are GABAergic inhibitory neurons.

span.label: inferior colliculus (IC)
span.quote: The inferior colliculus (IC), so named for its position relative to the superior colliculus (SC), is a major relay nucleus in the midbrain for ascending auditory information en route to the ipsilateral medial geniculate body of the thalamus.

span.label: three subdivisions of the IC
span.quote: It is generally agreed that three subdivisions exist in the IC of mammals (Fig. 1): the central nucleus (ICCN), external nucleus (EN), and the dorsal cortex (DC)

span.label: genetically epilepsy-prone rat (GEPR) and the 0-9 seizure score
span.term: genetically epilepsy-prone rat (GEPR) and the 0-9 seizure score
span.quote: Genetically epilepsy-prone rats (GEPRs) exhibit convulsions when exposed to sound stimulus, and the seizures are scored on a 0-9 scale (0 being no seizure, and 9 being one fit of wild running and an accompanying tonic seizure, culminating in tonic hind limb extension).

span.label: GEPR-3
span.quote: A rat strain that displays moderate seizures (running phase and forelimb/hindlimb clonus) and has an assigned seizure score of 3 (GEPR-3) is also used as an animal model for AGS (Jobe et al. 1986; Dailey et al. 1989; Mishra et al. 1989).

span.label: site of midbrain knife cut / lesion
span.term: site of midbrain knife cut / lesion
span.quote: A study was recently conducted in our laboratory to examine the effect of midbrain collicular knife cuts on AGS severity in the GEPR-9 (Ribak et al. 1994).

span.label: audiogenic seizure severity (audiogenic response score)
span.quote: Genetically epilepsy-prone rats (GEPRs) exhibit convulsions when exposed to sound stimulus, and the seizures are scored on a 0-9 scale (0 being no seizure, and 9 being one fit of wild running and an accompanying tonic seizure, culminating in tonic hind limb extension).

span.label: number and size class of neurons in the ICCN
span.term: number and size class of neurons in the ICCN
span.quote: Counts were made of the total number of Nissl-stained cells in the ICCN, and in addition, the three different sizes of ICCN neurons were separately counted (Roberts et al. 1985b).

span.label: Sprague-Dawley rats as the non-seizing comparison strain
span.term: Sprague-Dawley rats as the non-seizing comparison strain
span.quote: Significant increases in GABA levels and the number of GABAergic neurons are found in the central nucleus of the IC (ICCN) of genetically epilepsy-prone rats (GEPR-9s) as compared to Sprague- Dawley rats that do not display audiogenic seizures.

span.label: frontal cortex as a control brain region
span.term: frontal cortex as a control brain region
span.quote: As expected, no differences were found in the frontal cortex, since this region is not involved in AGS activity in this genetic model of epilepsy.

span.label: 200% — increase in small GAD-positive cells in the IC of GEPR-9s relative to Sprague-Dawley rats (medium cells increased 90%)
span.quote: This increase was most prominent in the middle of the rostrocaudal extent of the IC where the ICCN is most prominent and was largely due to a selective increase in small (200%) and medium (90%) GAD-positive cells.

span.label: 100% — increase in small Nissl-stained neurons in the ICCN of GEPRs, against a 30% increase for medium-sized neurons
span.quote: played the largest increase at 100%, followed by a 30% increase in the number of medium-sized neurons.

span.label: 70% — excess of small ICCN neurons in GEPR-9s over SD rats in the 2-micrometre semi-thin section counts, with medium neurons up 30%
span.quote: When these neurons were counted, it was found that both small (70%) and medium (30%) neurons in the ICCN of GEPR-9s were significantly more numerous than those in SD rats.

span.label: 25% ... 36% — proportion of small ICCN neurons that are GAD-positive in Sprague-Dawley rats versus GEPR-9s
span.quote: Approximately 25% of the total number of small neurons in the SD rat are GAD-positive, compared to 36% for the GEPR-9.

span.label: 0.91 — coefficient of linear correlation between audiogenic response score and the number of small ICCN neurons
span.quote: The coefficient of linear correlation was calculated to be 0.91, thus indicating that a significant correlation exists between audiogenic response score and small neuronal number in the ICCN.

span.label: 29.50+2.17 — mean small-neuron count per unit area in the ICCN of GEPR-3 rats
span.quote: The average number of small neurons in the ICCN of GEPR-3s was 29.50+2.17 cells per unit area.

span.label: 3:1 — minimum ratio of seizure-prone to seizure-resistant offspring in GEPR-9 x Sprague-Dawley crosses
span.quote: Studies of the offspring between GEPR-9s and normal Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats have revealed a ratio of seizure-prone to seizure-resistant offspring that is always greater than 3:1.

span.label: 28 rats — number of animals contributing to the correlation between small-neuron number and audiogenic response score
span.quote: Fig. I1 A graph that shows the relationship between the number of small neurons in the ICCN and the audiogenic response scores of 28 rats.
